description: WS-51 Series 2 Widgeon, first helicopter type of Brazilian Naval Aviation (1958-1968), c/n WA/H/142; outdoor park. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
WS-55 Series 3 Whirlwind (c/n WA692, ex PT-HQK), known in the Navy as 'Vaca', operated 1966-1982; outdoor park. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
Westland Wasp (c/n F.9542, ex Royal Navy XS476) 'Abelha', operated 1966-1991; outdoor park. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
AS-61D-3 Sea King (c/n 6055), cabin open to visitors; outdoor park. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
Pilatus P-3.04 trainer (s/n 336-18), ex-FAB 3180, used by the Navy 1963-1965; outdoor park. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
Bell 206B-2 Jet Ranger II used for naval pilot training 1974-1986; outdoor park. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
AS332F1 Super Puma (c/n 2217), retired 2018 and placed in the museum park after the 2019 refurbishment; cabin open to visitors. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
Helibras HB355 F2 Esquilo (c/n 5341) added to the outdoor park in mid-2024 (Gaceta Aeronáutica, Jan 2025).
Restored Tiger Moth in 1930s Aviação Naval markings suspended in the main hall; Navy used the type 1933-1941. Photographed Nov 2023 and Jan 2025.
Kawasaki-Bell 47G (c/n 1944), ex-FAB 8624 and civil PP-HUF, under restoration for the museum (reported Nov 2023 and Jan 2025).
Forward fuselage/cockpit section only, displayed indoors as a walk-in exhibit; instrument panel came from two-seat AF-1A N-1022. Nose section, not a complete airframe.
